info.title: Bulkgrid API
info.description: Search indexed content, create crawl and extraction runs, and retrieve results. API keys require the scopes listed for each operation. OAuth connections grant MCP and search access only.

post.summary: Create or subscribe to a source

delete.summary: Delete a source or remove its subscription

get.summary: List source changes for a run

urls.description: List of URLs to extract data from

query.description: Extraction query used to guide the extraction

schema.description: JSON schema defining the structure of data to extract

maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts for each URL
